data.description: A premium residential enclave offering elegant villas, world-class amenities, and seamless connectivity to key destinations in Dubai.

data.answer: Deema 2 offers an exceptional living experience characterized by its lush green landscapes and a host of premium amenities. The community is thoughtfully designed to cater to the diverse needs of its residents, ensuring a harmonious and fulfilling lifestyle. With its strategic location and comprehensive facilities, Deema 2 stands out as one of the best places to live in Dubai.

The properties in Deema 2 primarily consist of spacious 3 and 4-bedroom villas. These residences are designed to provide ample living space, modern interiors, and high-quality finishes, ensuring a comfortable and luxurious lifestyle for families.

Renting a Property in Deema 2

For those interested in properties for rent in Deema 2, the community offers a selection of 3 and 4-bedroom villas. These properties for rent in Dubai are ideal for families seeking a serene environment with access to top-notch amenities.

Buying a Property in Deema 2

Prospective buyers will find an array of 3 and 4-bedroom villas among the properties for sale in Deema 2. These properties for sale in Dubai present a lucrative opportunity for investors and homeowners alike, given the community's prime location and exceptional facilities.

Life in Deema 2 is marked by a harmonious blend of tranquility and convenience. The community's strategic location in The Lakes ensures residents have easy access to major roads, facilitating seamless commutes. With a range of amenities, including sports facilities, swimming pools, and play areas, families can enjoy an active and fulfilling lifestyle. The lush green surroundings and picturesque lakes further enhance the serene ambiance, making Deema 2 a coveted residential destination.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Deema 2

Deema 2 boasts excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai, with Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and Al Khail Road (E44) accessible within a 9-minute drive. Public transportation is facilitated by the nearby Al Khail Metro Station, located just 7 minutes away, ensuring residents can easily navigate the city. Each villa in Deema 2 is equipped with private parking, providing added convenience for residents with personal vehicles.

Supermarkets near Deema 2

For daily necessities, residents can visit Choithrams supermarket, conveniently located approximately a 3-minute drive from Deema 2. This proximity ensures that grocery shopping and other essentials are always within easy reach.

Shopping Malls near Deema 2

Shopping enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity of Dubai Marina Mall, situated about an 8-minute drive from Deema 2. The mall offers a diverse range of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities, providing a comprehensive shopping experience for residents.

Schools and Nurseries near Deema 2

Families with young children will find reputable educational institutions near Deema 2. British Orchard Nursery, located approximately 3 minutes away, offers early childhood education following the British curriculum.

For older students, Emirates International School Meadows, about a 9-minute drive from the community, provides the International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum, catering to students from Year 1 to Year 13.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Deema 2

Residents of Deema 2 have access to several nearby mosques. Masjid Bani Hashim is approximately a 5-minute drive away, while Masjid Al Wahhab can be reached in about 7 minutes.

For Hindu residents, places of worship such as the Shiva Temple and Shirdi Sai Baba Mandir are accessible within a 30 to 35-minute drive from Deema 2.

Christian residents can attend services at nearby churches. St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church is approximately a 15-minute drive away, and Christ Church Jebel Ali is about 16 minutes from Deema 2.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Deema 2

Healthcare needs are well-served with several clinics and hospitals in proximity to Deema 2. Mediclinic Meadows, offering a range of medical services, is approximately a 10-minute drive away. Al Zahra Hospital, known for its comprehensive healthcare facilities, is about 12 minutes from the community.

Deema 2 Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Deema 2 is surrounded by several prominent communities within Emirates Living, including The Greens, The Hills, Hattan, The Meadows, and The Views. These neighboring areas offer additional amenities and facilities, enhancing the overall living experience for Deema 2 residents.

Beyond Emirates Living, Deema 2 is in close proximity to other vibrant areas such as Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Islands, and Jumeirah Park. These communities provide a variety of lifestyle options and further enrich the residential experience.

Residents of Deema 2 can indulge in various recreational activities, thanks to the community's well-designed amenities. From sports facilities to serene parks, there is something for everyone to enjoy within this vibrant neighborhood.

Deema 2 Restaurants

A variety of dining options are available near Deema 2, particularly in The Springs Souk, which is within a 10-minute drive. Here, residents can enjoy diverse cuisines at restaurants such as Le Pain Quotidien, Asia Tang Restaurant, Big Boss Burger, and Zaatar w Zeit. 

Additionally, Hunter & Barrel offers a contemporary dining experience specializing in charcoal-grilled dishes, Carine Restaurant provides a taste of French Mediterranean cuisine, and Amritsr Restaurant serves authentic North Indian flavors; all are within a 10-minute drive from Deema 2.

Beaches near Deema 2

Beach enthusiasts will appreciate the community's proximity to some of Dubai's finest beaches. Jumeirah Beach, known for its pristine sands and clear waters, is approximately a 15-minute drive away and offers amenities such as beachfront dining and water sports. 

Kite Beach, favored by kite surfers and families, is about 18 minutes from Deema 2 and features outdoor gyms, food trucks, and children's play areas. 

Marina Beach, located within Dubai Marina, is roughly a 12-minute drive away and provides facilities including open gyms, children's play zones, and a variety of cafes and restaurants.

Hotels near Deema 2

For visitors, several upscale hotels are located near Deema 2. The Address Montgomerie, offering luxurious accommodations and a championship golf course, is approximately a 10-minute drive away. Armada BlueBay Hotel, known for its modern amenities and proximity to key attractions, is about 12 minutes from Deema 2.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Deema 2 provides ample opportunities for outdoor recreation, including parks, sports courts, and an outdoor gym. Fitness centers cater to residents looking to stay active, while beauty salons offer premium grooming and wellness services.

Deema 2 Attractions and Landmarks

Emirates Golf Club, just a 10-minute drive from Deema 2, is a premier golfing destination offering world-class facilities. Golf enthusiasts can enjoy its championship courses, state-of-the-art practice areas, and a variety of dining options, making it a favored spot for both amateurs and professionals.

Dubai Marina Walk, also 10 minutes away, features waterfront dining, retail outlets, and leisure activities. This picturesque promenade is ideal for leisurely strolls, jogging, or enjoying a meal with views of the marina's stunning architecture and moored yachts.

Skydive Dubai, a 14-minute drive from Deema 2, provides an exhilarating skydiving experience over the iconic Palm Jumeirah. Adventurers can tandem skydive from heights up to 13,000 feet, experiencing freefall speeds of 120 miles per hour, all while taking in breathtaking aerial views of Dubai's coastline.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

Various outdoor activities are available to residents of Deema 2. Fitness options include well-equipped gyms, while salons for both men and women ensure convenient personal care services within the vicinity.

Deema 2 offers a premium lifestyle with excellent amenities and a tranquil environment. While public transportation options are slightly limited, the well-connected road network and proximity to metro stations make commuting hassle-free.

What types of properties are available in Deema 2?

Deema 2 offers spacious 3 and 4-bedroom villas for rent and sale.

What amenities are available in Deema 2?

Residents enjoy swimming pools, sports courts, play areas, barbecue zones, and an outdoor gym.

How far is Deema 2 from major highways?

Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and Al Khail Road (E44) are within a 9-minute drive.

Are there schools near Deema 2?

Yes, British Orchard Nursery and Emirates International School Meadows are nearby.

What shopping options are available?

Dubai Marina Mall, just 8 minutes away, offers retail, dining, and entertainment options.

data.content:
Deema 2, nestled within The Lakes community of Emirates Living, is a distinguished residential enclave developed by Emaar Properties. Strategically positioned along First Al Khail Street, this serene neighborhood offers residents both tranquility and convenience. Its prime location ensures swift connectivity to major thoroughfares, with Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and Al Khail Road (E44) just minutes away.

Established in 2003, Deema 2 exemplifies Emaar's commitment to quality and community living. The neighborhood features an array of luxurious villas available for both rent and sale, catering to families seeking a harmonious blend of comfort and elegance. The meticulously landscaped surroundings and picturesque lakes enhance the community's appeal, making it a sought-after destination for discerning residents.

Residents of Deema 2 enjoy access to a plethora of amenities designed to enrich their lifestyle. The community boasts well-maintained barbecue areas, inviting swimming pools—including dedicated children's pools—and expansive outdoor play areas for the younger residents. For sports enthusiasts, facilities such as tennis courts, basketball courts, football fields, volleyball courts, and an outdoor gym are readily available, fostering a vibrant and active community atmosphere.
